ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels (approx. 10%) to low-intensity pixels (approx. 90%); surface is predominantly low-intensity black with concentrated white/grey highlights at the distal tips and scattered surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast clusters located at both distal tips; distinct vertical linear pixel arrangements on the left lobe; multiple circular and ring-like pixel groupings localized on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the visible vertical fluke profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge with frequent peak-to-valley transitions; amplitudes range from 2 to 10 pixels; highest irregularity concentration located on the right lobe medial trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex sweep across the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning into localized concavity immediately prior to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white pixel clusters (intensity >240) at lobe tips; discrete circular ring patterns (approx. 5-8 instances) mapped across the right lobe surface area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of 4 parallel, vertically oriented linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the mid-left lobe surface, slightly higher intensity than surrounding black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular trailing edge notch on the right lobe medial section; dense clusters of barnacles at both distal tips forming irregular physical protrusion boundaries.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetrical upward-curling distal tips with high-contrast white barnacle colonies distinct from the main black fluke body.
